scripts.format: prettier --write frontend backend shared tests scripts docs README.md CONTRIBUTING.md SECURITY.md package.json .prettierrc.json .github/workflows/*.yml vite.config.ts eslint.config.js tsconfig.*.json wrangler*.jsonc
scripts.format:check: prettier --check frontend backend shared tests scripts docs README.md CONTRIBUTING.md SECURITY.md package.json .prettierrc.json .github/workflows/*.yml vite.config.ts eslint.config.js tsconfig.*.json wrangler*.jsonc
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && npm run perf:assets && npm run worker:check
scripts.db:seed:local: wrangler d1 execute commercecore-db --local --file backend/db/seed/catalog.sql && wrangler d1 execute commercecore-db --local --file backend/db/seed/storefront.sql && wrangler d1 execute commercecore-db --local --file backend/db/seed/expanded.sql
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply commercecore-db --remote --config wrangler.production.jsonc
scripts.deploy: node scripts/guard-deploy.mjs && npm run check && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.production.jsonc
